title: Tom Pelissero had a year left on his NFLN deal

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Tom Pelissero had a year left on his NFLN deal
sources.description: When ESPN acquired NFL Network, frayed nerves at NFLN were calmed by the news that ESPN would honor the existing contracts with on-air personnel, and that ESPN would make a decision when the current deals end.
